title: Cosmic Garden Entity
description: A surreal painting depicts a large smiling dual-faced figure with brown skin and white swirling hair, seated in a mechanical cauldron-like vessel with robotic legs. The vessel rests on a circular platform decorated with flowers, bones, seashells and dripping green ooze, set against a desert landscape with floating planets, flaming cosmic rings, and staircases leading into a green planet.
prompt: Surreal desert scene featuring a giant smiling figure with one brown face and one yellow face, white swirling hair adorned with purple leaves, sitting inside a dark mechanical cauldron with robotic spider-like legs. The cauldron sits on a circular platform bordered by red flowers, bones, seashells and dripping green slime. In the background are floating blue and green planets encircled by flaming orange rings, staircases ascending into space, and small potted plants on tiled ground.
